service.notRunningTitle: The Kitvei Hakodesh service is not responding
service.notRunningBody: Books and search are unavailable right now. The service may be restarting - please click "Try again".
service.notInstalledTitle: The Kitvei Hakodesh service is not installed
service.notInstalledBody: Books and search need this service, and it is not installed on this computer. You can install it now: clicking "Install service" installs it, and Windows will ask for administrator approval.
service.installDeclinedBody: Books and search need the Kitvei Hakodesh service, and installing it requires administrator approval. Please click "Try again" and approve the permission prompt.
service.installFailedBody: Books and search need the Kitvei Hakodesh service, but installing or repairing it failed. Please click "Try again"; if the problem persists, reinstall the program (Klei Kodesh).
service.startFailedBody: The Kitvei Hakodesh service is installed, but Windows does not start it. Clicking "Repair" repairs it, and Windows will ask for administrator approval.
service.dbInterruptedTitle: The Otzaria library update did not finish
service.dbInterruptedBody: The Otzaria book library update was interrupted, so books cannot load right now. Please open Otzaria and let it finish the update - the library will reload here automatically. Do not delete files in the library folder.
service.dbMissingBody: No book library was found on this computer, so books and search are unavailable. Download the library from the home page, or click "Choose library" to point to an existing seforim.db file.
service.dbUnreadableBody: The book library file exists but cannot be opened (not a valid database, corrupted, or locked by another program). Click "Choose library" to pick another file.

update.title: New version available
update.body: Klei Kodesh version {version} has been downloaded and is ready to install. Installing will close Word and the program.
update.installFailed: The installer could not be started. Please try again later.
